reference: Answer for the part of the business you know, thinking about the last six months. Rate each statement from strongly disagree to strongly agree, with neutral at the midpoint.

context.title: Which result matters most over the next 12 months?

options.label: Win more of the right work
Move projects or commitments forward faster
Handle more work with the team we have
Develop a new service or wider business model

context.title: Which project stages do you know best?
context.help: Choose up to two, or select the full lifecycle.

context.title: Where does progress most often get stuck?

options.label: Finding and trusting data or evidence

sections.title: AI today
sections.subtitle: Where use sits, and whether it has changed the work.

questions.text: Which forms of AI are in use in the work you know?

options.label: AI features or plug-ins in existing software
A shared team agent or automation
AI built into an agreed workflow

questions.text: How widely is AI used in this part of the business?
I have access to an approved AI tool for work I do regularly.
People here use AI for repeatable work, not only one-off prompts.
We can build or adapt a task-specific agent when there is a clear use for it.
AI has changed an agreed team workflow, not just made individual tasks faster.

sections.title: Workflow
sections.subtitle: Can the work scale without the same people resolving every blockage?

questions.text: Our priority work follows agreed stages that people actually use.
The next important decision has a clear owner.
People can see where an opportunity or project is held up.
Handover to the next team preserves the decisions already made.
Problems are escalated before they threaten a key date.
Recurring delays lead us to change the workflow.

sections.title: Data and evidence
sections.subtitle: Can people and AI work from information they can trust?

questions.text: We can quickly find the latest approved information needed for live work.
We can trace important figures and claims back to their source.
Key data and documents have an owner responsible for keeping them current.
Information is checked for accuracy before it is reused.
We can reuse approved information without rebuilding it from scratch.
The people doing the work can access the information they need when they need it.

sections.title: Governance
sections.subtitle: Are AI use, outputs and decisions accountable?

questions.text: People know which AI tools are approved for company work.
People know what information must not be entered into an AI tool.
A named person is accountable for each AI-assisted workflow we rely on.
A person checks AI-assisted work before it informs an important decision.
We can identify what AI contributed to an important output.
There is a clear way to report and correct a problem with an AI-assisted output.

sections.title: Winning work
sections.subtitle: Is AI improving live opportunities, auctions or bids?

questions.text: AI is used in live work to pursue opportunities, not just in experiments.
AI helps us identify requirements, risks or gaps before we commit.
AI helps us find or assemble evidence for customers, partners or submissions.
AI helps us compare options before a commercial decision.
Useful AI-assisted work is shared with the team rather than staying with one individual.
We can point to a recent improvement in winning work that AI helped produce.

sections.title: Delivering work
sections.subtitle: Is AI helping work and commitments move forward?

questions.text: AI is used in live procurement, project or contract work, not just in experiments.
AI helps us track commitments or obligations as work moves forward.
AI helps us find evidence needed to answer project or stakeholder questions.
AI helps us spot missing information or inconsistencies before they cause rework.
AI helps carry relevant context from one team or project stage to the next.
We can point to a recent improvement in delivery work that AI helped produce.

sections.title: New opportunities
sections.subtitle: Could AI support a new offer or a wider role?

questions.text: We have identified a customer problem that AI could help us solve in a new way.
We have considered whether AI could let us take on a wider role in the project lifecycle.
We have discussed an AI-enabled service or wider role with a real customer or buyer.
We have tested the commercial case for at least one such opportunity.
We understand the capabilities and responsibilities that opportunity would require.
We have tested a small version of the idea before committing to scale it.
